race.comment: OLYMPIAN (4) was well in commission last start in a 1600m Randwick Highway but he settled a long way back and only got going late in the piece. Fitter for two runs back from a spell. Can make amends with Aaron Bullock replacing a 3kgs claiming apprentice. THINK LIKE PADDY (1) made late ground but never looked like the winner in the same Randwick Highway as OLYMPIAN three weeks ago. Has been up for a long while but continues to be competitive. In the mix again with Nash going on. CREATIVE RIGHTEOUS (3) came from last to get up for second in the 1450m Kempsey Cup recently. Has a strong record at this distance and is more than capable of matching it with this field. Boom four-year-old COSTA DEL SOL (12) has won two from two at $1.14 and $1.30, the latest over 1450m at Muswellbrook. Very smart but the outside gate will test him today. The lightly raced IMELDA (9) is going around at skinny quotes and getting the job done. May have even more to offer now with the blinkers applied.
